San Francisco from Twin Peaks

Study after Yoshida Hatsusaburō

A bird’s-eye view after the panoramic railway maps (chōkanzu) of Yoshida Hatsusaburō (1884–1955). The centre is enlarged; the surrounding terrain is compressed toward a curved horizon, where distant places are set at their true bearings.

Elevation from Terrarium tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data) at 12.5 m within 4 km of Twin Peaks and 50 m to 24 km. Radius is logarithmic in distance, relief is exaggerated toward the rim, and slopes are stepped at 24 m. Drawn in the browser.
